prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use refined warm lifestyle editorial photography: considered light and composition with relaxed believable interaction, never a glossy advertising pose. A couple aged 70 and 75 share a gentle slow dance in their home living room during a small anniversary celebration, smiling at each other with hands comfortably joined. They wear ordinary soft formal clothes; a lamp and flowers stay softly behind them. Use intimate considered framing and warm practical light that keeps faces and hands clear. Output a square 1:1 composition for a website gallery. Make the key expressions and interaction readable at thumbnail size, with breathing room around the subjects. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Additional subject and framing requirements: The 70-year-old wife has a short straight white bob, a softly square face and no glasses. The 75-year-old husband has neatly combed thin grey hair, a clean-shaven angular face and small round glasses. Keep them distinct from other elderly people, ordinary and convincingly aged. Exact square 1:1, show their gently joined hands clearly, a comfortable unforced dance posture and enough room around both heads.
review: Reviewed square photograph: white-bob-haired older wife and clean-shaven grey-haired husband with round glasses slow-dance in a home living room. Joined hands and supporting hand at waist are anatomically plausible, faces naturally aged and distinct. Warm lamps and simple anniversary table, no text or artificial band.
